name: v215_news12_downspeed_relief
hypothesis: After-news price path speed may capture event digestion rather than ordinary close/open reversal. Stocks that avoid fast downside threshold breaches while not showing noisy session ranges should have cleaner post-event absorption.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(main_minutes_to_one_pct_down_move), 60), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(minutes_to_two_pct_down_move_1555), 60), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(session_range_standard_deviation), 60), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(trading_volume_standard_deviation_2), 60), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(relative_performance_vs_benchmark_1555), 60), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Uses vector news12 path-speed fields via vec_avg. Avoids close/open, FCF/EPS, treasury, book, contract, and option sleeves.

name: v215_news12_fast_up_slow_down
hypothesis: Construct a directional event-path asymmetry: faster upside threshold crossing and slower downside crossing after news should indicate favorable information absorption distinct from broad news sentiment.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(minutes_to_one_pct_up_move_1555), 60), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(main_minutes_to_one_pct_down_move), 60), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(performance_vs_benchmark), 60), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(session_range_to_atr_ratio_2), 60), industry) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(current_to_average_volume_ratio_2), 60), industry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Tests threshold speed asymmetry and market-relative event performance. Reject if it maps to WjpJwMdP/news-chain or mL86Jle1/VWAP capacity.

name: v215_news12_low_noise_relperf
hypothesis: Low-noise event sessions with positive benchmark-adjusted performance may identify clean information response rather than crowded sentiment or intraday reversal.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(vec_avg(current_to_average_volume_ratio_2), 60) < 0.65, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(relative_performance_vs_benchmark_1555), 60), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(low_price_deviation_std_1555), 60), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(high_price_deviation_std_1555), 60), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(session_range_standard_deviation), 60), industry) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(minutes_to_one_percent_gain_2), 60), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Gates on moderate event volume to avoid pure attention spikes. No ordinary news18 sentiment or option stabilizer.

name: v215_news12_threshold_reversal_residual
hypothesis: Very fast large post-news moves can mean overreaction. A residual that shorts fast extreme threshold crossings while preferring calmer market-relative response may differ from close/open reversal.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(min_minutes_to_three_pct_move_2_1555), 60), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(minimum_minutes_to_two_percent_move), 60), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(five_minute_price_change_pct_3)), 60), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(relative_performance_vs_benchmark_1555), 60), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(main_trading_volume_deviation_std), 60), industry) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: A calmer threshold-speed residual, not a direct close/open or VWAP signal. Watch for weak Sharpe and news12 field type errors.
